Emergency Care
24-Hour Emergency Veterinary Clinic in Cairo and Giza
Dr. Paws Veterinary Team
Clinically reviewed pet-care guidance
Updated 19/07/2026
4 min read
When your pet faces a medical emergency, every minute counts. Dr. Paws Veterinary Clinic is Cairo and Giza’s trusted
emergency vet
, a fully equipped
24-hour emergency veterinary clinic in Cairo and Giza
dedicated to providing prompt, expert care — whether it’s an injury, a sudden illness, or any other urgent health concern. Our doors are open around the clock so that you never have to wait when your pet needs help most.
Why Choose Dr. Paws?
Not every veterinary clinic is equipped to handle true emergencies, and not every clinic operates around the clock. As a leading
Cairo and Giza 24-hour animal hospital
, Dr. Paws was established to fill that gap. Our facility is staffed at all hours by trained veterinarians and experienced support staff who are prepared to respond quickly and effectively to a wide range of critical situations. We treat both cats and dogs, and our clinic is outfitted with modern diagnostic and surgical equipment, allowing us to move from diagnosis to treatment without delay. As
Dr. Paws vet Cairo and Giza 24/7
, we are available at any hour to handle both emergencies and routine visits, making us a reliable veterinary home for your pet year-round.
What Sets Us Apart
A great veterinary clinic does more than treat illness — it provides reassurance. At Dr. Paws, we prioritize clear and honest communication. When your pet is brought in, we take the time to explain the diagnosis, walk you through your options, and outline the next steps before any treatment begins. Whether you need
Cairo and Giza emergency vet services
at 3 AM or a routine check-up during the day, we want you to feel informed and confident throughout the process.
Our Location
Finding an
emergency vet clinic in Cairo and Giza
should never be difficult, especially during a crisis. Dr. Paws Veterinary Clinic is situated at
B1, First 6th of October, Giza Governorate 12511
, in the heart of Cairo and Giza. This central location makes us easily accessible whether you live nearby or are traveling in from a surrounding area during an urgent situation. Know more about
24 hour vet clinic near me
Services We Offer
Emergency Veterinary Care
— We are equipped to handle a full spectrum of emergencies, from trauma and poisoning to sudden illness and life-threatening conditions. Our
Cairo and Giza emergency vet services
are available same-day, at any hour.
Veterinary Surgery in Cairo and Giza Emergencies
— Our surgeons are experienced in both emergency and elective procedures. When
veterinary surgery in a Cairo and Giza emergency
is the best course of action, we are ready to act quickly and safely.
Animal Lab Tests in Cairo and Giza Emergencies
— Accurate diagnosis is the foundation of effective treatment. We offer on-site
animal lab tests
to help identify conditions promptly, ensuring the right treatment plan is put in place without unnecessary delays.
Cat Vet Clinic Cairo and Giza 24 Hours
— We provide specialized emergency and routine care for feline patients. If your cat needs urgent attention at any hour, our dedicated team is ready to help around the clock.
Vaccinations & Routine Care
— In addition to emergency services, we provide standard vaccinations, health check-ups, and preventive care to keep your pet healthy and protected throughout the year.
Dr. Paws Veterinary Clinic — trusted emergency and routine veterinary care in Cairo and Giza, available whenever your pet needs it.
Frequently Asked Questions
What emergency services does Dr. Paws provide?
As a full-service Cairo and Giza 24-hour animal hospital, we offer urgent care for injuries, illnesses, and life-threatening conditions, along with emergency surgery and on-site diagnostic testing. Our team is available 24/7.
Is Dr. Paws open all night?
Yes. Dr. Paws vet Cairo and Giza 24/7 operates on a full 24-hour schedule, every day of the week. Whether your pet’s emergency occurs in the middle of the night or early in the morning, we are here to help.
Do you treat cats?
Absolutely. As a cat vet clinic in Cairo and Giza open 24 hours, we provide both emergency and routine care for cats. If your feline needs urgent attention at any hour, our team is ready.
Written and reviewed by: Dr. Sara – Veterinarian and medical content specialist for pet care at Dr Paws.
Medical note: This content is for awareness only and does not replace a veterinary examination. If your pet has severe symptoms such as breathing difficulty, bleeding, suspected poisoning, urinary blockage, repeated vomiting, seizures, or sudden lethargy, contact a veterinary clinic immediately.
